items.headline: Ugreen's new smart home ecosystem is built around local AI hubs
items.excerpt: Ugreen unveiled a lineup of local-AI smart home hubs that process data on-device instead of in the cloud, spanning $1,799 to $20,000 models plus cameras, a voice assistant called Uliya and an e-ink frame.

items.headline: Anker Eufy at IFA 2026: New security cameras, plus a robot vacuum and a robot lawnmower
items.excerpt: Anker's Eufy brand used IFA 2026 to push AI-driven home security, adding new cameras alongside a robot vacuum and a robotic lawnmower. Security was the focus of the lineup this year.

items.headline: Roborock shows off a series of new vacuums at IFA 2026
items.excerpt: Roborock brought several new AI-navigating robovacs, a robomower and a pool cleaner to IFA 2026, extending obstacle-recognition and autonomous cleaning across more of the home.

items.headline: Atlas promises 'a new generation of brain wearable' with its first neural tracker
items.excerpt: The $499 Atlas 1.0 Pioneer Edition is a behind-the-ear neural tracker that reads brain signals to score stress, attention and energy. The first pre-order batch sold out immediately.

items.headline: Does Apple's Live Rewind really turn the Apple Watch into a 'mass surveillance device'?
items.excerpt: Apple's new Live Rewind feature has the Apple Watch continuously buffering sensor data on-device, and TechRadar breaks down how the privacy tech behind it actually works.

items.headline: IFA 2026 'Best in Show' awards: our 25 favorite reveals at the Berlin tech expo
items.excerpt: TechRadar's pick of IFA 2026's most interesting hardware, from somersaulting robots to modular solar batteries — a snapshot of where AI is actually landing in consumer devices.

items.headline: Anker just launched a ton of new products at IFA 2026 — including an AI-powered home hub
items.excerpt: Anker unified its sub-brands and announced 22 new products at IFA 2026, headlined by its own AI home hub that coordinates the company's smart-home hardware.

items.headline: iRobot Roomba Duo is the Transformers of robot vacuums — and we just saw it live
items.excerpt: iRobot's Roomba Duo prototype pairs a heavy wet-dry floor washer with a mechanical arm that lowers a smaller companion robot into tight spaces — a rethink of robovac form factor rather than spec wars.

items.headline: Best of IFA 2026: We found the 26 top new gadgets
items.excerpt: Tom's Guide rounds up the 26 standout devices of IFA 2026, including the Acer DualPlay Mini and Nvidia RTX Spark-class AI hardware aimed at local AI workloads.

items.headline: iPhone 18 Pro Launching on September 18 With These 10 New Features
items.excerpt: Apple's iPhone 18 Pro pairs the 2nm A20 Pro and its 32-core Neural Engine with a variable-aperture 48MP camera, shipping with iOS 27 and the rebuilt Siri AI. Pre-orders open September 12.

items.headline: Everything Apple Announced at the September 2026 Event
items.excerpt: Apple's 'Surprise and Shine' event introduced the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, the foldable iPhone Duo, new Apple Watch models and AirPods 5, with Siri AI threaded through the lineup.

items.headline: SwitchBot's AI MindClip is ready to ship, and early buyers can grab it for just $100
items.excerpt: SwitchBot launched the AI MindClip, a clip-on wearable that transcribes conversations, identifies speakers and turns notes into tasks automatically — a $100 entry point for always-on AI capture.

items.headline: The best tech of IFA 2026: A repairable laptop, liquid-cooled power bank, AI toothbrush, and more
items.excerpt: Digital Trends' IFA 2026 highlights show AI seeping into unglamorous hardware — a repairable laptop, tiny ANC earbuds, giant projectors and even an AI toothbrush.

items.headline: First Clear Visuals Of Meta's Project Phoenix Headset Found In Quest Firmware
items.excerpt: Quest firmware has surfaced the first clear images of Meta's Project Phoenix: a slim headset with glasses-style nose pads tethered to a compute puck, ahead of Connect 2026.

items.headline: Apple confirms Siri AI launches in English this month, will add five languages in October
items.excerpt: Apple says the rebuilt Siri AI ships in English with iOS 27 on September 14, with French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese and Spanish following in October.

items.headline: Google brings Gemini for desktop app to Windows
items.excerpt: After April's macOS debut, Google's native Gemini desktop app comes to Windows with an Alt + Space shortcut, putting the assistant a keystroke away on PCs.

items.headline: Aoostar teases powerful AMD-powered mini PC with up to 192GB of RAM
items.excerpt: Aoostar's Nex495S packs AMD's top Ryzen AI Max+ Pro 495 APU with up to 192GB of RAM, as much as 160GB of which can be assigned as VRAM — a desktop-sized box for running large local models.
